mainEntity.name: What are the common material choices for second-story decks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for second-story decks include pressure-treated lumber, composite decking, and natural hardwoods like cedar or redwood. Pressure-treated wood is cost-effective and durable, while composite materials offer low maintenance and a wide range of colors. Hardwoods provide a premium aesthetic but require more regular maintenance. The best choice often depends on your budget, desired aesthetics, and maintenance preferences, which we discuss during design consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Material options for second-story decks include pressure-treated wood, composite, and hardwoods. Your choice depends on budget, aesthetics, and maintenance preferences, which Hometelligent Inc. can help you evaluate.
